# GitHub Secrets Required for AOSI Runner

Go to: Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret

Add these three secrets:

| Name | Value |
|------|-------|
| GREG_NOTIFY_FROM | your Gmail address |
| GREG_NOTIFY_PASSWORD | your Gmail app password |
| GREG_NOTIFY_TO | your personal email |

Once added, Greg will tick every 30 minutes automatically.
